widgets.title: Tags on This Page
widgets.description: Shows a tag cloud built from the tags used on whatever page it's placed on. On a topic/article page it reads the tags directly; on a feed or category listing page (where tags aren't shown per card) it follows the linked articles in the background and pulls their tags in too. Click a tag to search the community for it.

properties.name: title
properties.label: Widget title
properties.description: Heading shown above the tag cloud.

properties.name: maxTags
properties.label: Max tags to show
properties.description: Caps how many distinct tags are displayed, most-used first.

properties.name: showCounts
properties.label: Show tag counts
properties.description: Display how many times each tag appears alongside the tag.

properties.name: maxItemsToScan
properties.label: Max linked items to scan (feed pages)
properties.description: On a feed/listing page, caps how many linked articles are checked in the background for tags. Keeps large feeds fast. Has no effect on an individual topic page, since tags there are read directly with no extra fetching.
